description: Xaverus mint policy: allow = xVerified AND uidClaimed AND NOT revoked. NAND-only netlist synthesized from circuits/policy-circuit.v with Yosys 0.33 (abc -g NAND, then $_NOT_ mapped to NAND with tied inputs). See docs/TAPEOUT_POLICY_CIRCUIT.md for the derivation and the equivalence proof (exhaustive simulation of all 8 input combinations).

inputMap.r: revoked: the Human Proof has been revoked (always 0 in v1)
inputMap.u: uidClaimed: the minting wallet signed its OKX UID claim
inputMap.x: xVerified: the minting wallet completed X OAuth and signed the binding

name: policy-circuit
